MATCH (a:PlantItem {tag: 'T-2501'}), (b:PlantItem {tag: 'PSV-25023'})

UNWIND nodes(p) AS item
WITH item
WHERE item.kind IN ['equipment', 'valve']
RETURN item.tag AS tag
ORDER BY length(shortestPath((a)-[:line_to*]->(item))) ASC

ORDER BY i

MATCH (a:PlantItem {tag: 'EA-2001'}), (b:PlantItem {tag: 'PSV-20006'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:line_to*]->(b))

UNWIND range(0, size(route) - 1) AS i

WHERE item:Equipment OR item:Valve
RETURN item.tag AS tag
ORDER BY i;
